hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A contiguous sequence is alternating if adjacent elements have different parity.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Compute prefix lengths of alternating sequences ending at each index and suffix lengths starting at each index.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Consider skipping element i: if elements at i - 1 and i + 1 have opposite parity, combine the prefix and suffix lengths.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Three linear scans over the array compute prefix and suffix lengths and evaluate element removals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
